articles.title: Some video games offer mental-health benefits
articles.snippet: The PlaySmart video game lowered teens’ symptoms of depression. This benefit was still there a year after they stopped playing the game.
articles.summary: The PlaySmart video game helped lower depression symptoms in teenagers. This mental health benefit lasted for a full year after the teens stopped playing the game.

articles.title: Four T. rex footprints hint at how fast it traveled
articles.snippet: Though poorly preserved, the prints suggest the dino ambled at 1.6 meters per second, roughly the speed of a human walking briskly.
articles.summary: Four poorly preserved T. rex footprints suggest that the dinosaur walked at a speed of 1.6 meters per second. This speed is roughly the same as a human walking briskly.

articles.title: Seals long ago evolved to hear above the water — and below
articles.snippet: Spongy tissue that fills with blood makes this possible, show X-ray scans of hundreds of ears from seals and other animals.
articles.summary: X-ray scans show that seals have spongy tissue filled with blood in their ears. This special adaptation allows seals to hear both above and below the water.
